data.text: I’ll commit to 18 tons this month if all five of us agree before choosing, and I support Emma’s stock-dependent limits afterward. Let’s keep the 10-ton reserve for now rather than change the agreement midstream. Jack, a 5-ton reserve has the same chance of external replenishment, but it leaves only 10 tons after a failed refill instead of 20, so we should weigh the longer-term income difference before switching. Kate, are you willing to join the agreement? Then Emma can explicitly confirm her commitment.
